2. Modification of Emily's reply skill

3. The equipment set skill can take effect correctly

4. Questions fed back by other players

5. Fix daily task bugs and optimize the initial difficulty of daily tasks

6. Login background music can be changed according to settings

7. Battle Soul Store increases the refresh rate of fairy princess

8. Reward task bug repair

9. Modification of Emily's reply skill

10. Increased equipment trial experience

11. Adjustment of points segment demand in the arena

12. Optimization of top bar horselight announcement

notes.title: Version Update2022.12.02
notes.content:
[b] Update content [/b]

1. The game is transferred from the release team to the development team, and the customer service speed and problem feedback will be able to get the first response. If you have any questions, please contact the customer service QQ: 2096617054 at any time

2. The new Zone 2 is open. Welcome to the experience

3. Game content update

1) Add a new map: Blue Mountains

2) Add new heroes:

3) Add new activities: recharge rebate, lord upgrade gift package, city hall upgrade gift package

4) Optimized the numerical experience of the game according to the test results

5) Optimized the map of Treasure Raiders

6) Optimized game performance and smoother experience

7) Fixed player feedback and some experience problems.
